projects.title: RAG Document Q&A Assistant
projects.description: Build an intelligent document search system that extracts PDF text, embeds chunks into a vector database, and answers user questions with grounded Gemini citations.
deliverables: FastAPI endpoint to upload documents and generate vector embeddings
Semantic similarity search pipeline with cosine distance
Grounded generation prompt returning source page citations

projects.title: End-to-End Customer Churn Predictor
projects.description: Develop and deploy a classification model using Scikit-Learn to predict customer churn, evaluate ROC-AUC, and expose prediction endpoints via FastAPI.
deliverables: Jupyter notebook detailing EDA, feature scaling, and model selection
Trained Random Forest model serialized with Joblib
FastAPI /predict endpoint returning churn probabilities

projects.title: Autonomous Coding Agent with Tool Calling
projects.description: Create an AI agent that accepts multi-step user prompts, executes terminal commands or Python code in a safe sandbox, and loops until the goal is solved.
deliverables: ReAct (Reason + Act) loop handling structured function calling
Isolated Docker container execution sandbox
CLI or streaming web interface showing real-time agent thoughts

projects.title: Computer Vision Image Classifier with PyTorch
projects.description: Train a convolutional neural network (CNN) on CIFAR-10 or custom dataset using PyTorch, apply data augmentations, and optimize test accuracy.
deliverables: PyTorch training script with learning rate scheduling and early stopping
Validation confusion matrix and loss curve plots
Inference script classifying unseen images

projects.title: Full-Stack Task & Sprint Kanban Board
projects.description: Architect a Trello-style collaboration board with drag-and-drop columns, optimistic UI updates in React, and persistent MongoDB document storage.
deliverables: React frontend with smooth drag-and-drop column reordering
RESTful FastAPI CRUD endpoints for boards, lists, and tasks
MongoDB schema with indexed board references

projects.title: Interactive Analytics Dashboard with Recharts
projects.description: Build an executive metrics dashboard visualizing time-series revenue, user engagement, and retention metrics with interactive date filters.
deliverables: Responsive grid layout built with Tailwind CSS
Recharts AreaChart, BarChart, and PieChart data visualizations
TypeScript interfaces for API data models

projects.title: Real-Time Collaborative Code Snippet Editor
projects.description: Create a live markdown/code sharing web application with syntax highlighting, instant preview, and secure GitHub OAuth login.
deliverables: Monaco or Prism code editor component with live markdown preview
Shareable snippet URLs with permission toggles (public / private)
Docker Compose configuration for one-command local launch

projects.title: High-Throughput Rate-Limited API Gateway
projects.description: Build an asynchronous reverse proxy in FastAPI that authenticates incoming requests, applies Token Bucket rate limiting, and forwards to upstream microservices.
deliverables: Token bucket rate limiting middleware with sliding window algorithm
Structured JSON logging with request IDs for distributed tracing
Dockerized setup with comprehensive Pytest integration tests

projects.title: E-Commerce Order & Inventory Engine
projects.description: Implement a transactional backend handling product catalogs, shopping carts, inventory reservations, and checkout workflows with strict ACID guarantees.
deliverables: Relational schema with normalized tables, foreign keys, and indexes
Atomic database transactions preventing double-selling inventory
Complete OpenAPI documentation with request validation

projects.title: Distributed Asynchronous Job Worker System
projects.description: Create a background task processing engine that receives heavy computing jobs via an API, distributes work across workers, and tracks status.
deliverables: Async job queue with failure retries and exponential backoff
Worker process running independently in separate Docker container
WebSocket or polling endpoint for real-time job progress
